title: Deck frontmatter (brief and plan)
description: Two documents make a Deck: presentations/<slug>/brief.md carries the dials, presentations/<slug>/plan.md carries the planner output. A file validates against exactly one of them.
$comment: brief.md body is free-text brief plus optional per-section instructions. plan.md body is the table "slide | layout | units | fit | note" followed by the fit report.

deck.description: Deck slug; matches the directory name.

title.description: Human deck title; becomes the Canva design name.

audience.$comment: Closed enum. Source of truth: spec/vocab/audience.json. JSON Schema cannot load the vocab at runtime, so validate.mjs injects the enum from that file; keep this array in sync with it.

purpose.$comment: Closed enum. Source of truth: spec/vocab/purpose.json. JSON Schema cannot load the vocab at runtime, so validate.mjs injects the enum from that file; keep this array in sync with it.
purpose.description: What the deck is for; selects the default flow_template (see examples in spec/vocab/purpose.json).

delivery_mode.$comment: Closed enum. Source of truth: spec/vocab/delivery_mode.json. JSON Schema cannot load the vocab at runtime, so validate.mjs injects the enum from that file; keep this array in sync with it.
delivery_mode.description: How the deck is delivered; sets the default density (research/03 §c script rule).

flow_template.$comment: Closed enum. Source of truth: spec/vocab/flow_template.json. JSON Schema cannot load the vocab at runtime, so validate.mjs injects the enum from that file; keep this array in sync with it.
flow_template.description: Explicit flow override, or "auto" to take the purpose default.

length_minutes.description: Speaking time. 0 for a read-deck. With target_slides 0, the budget comes from this and the pace norms (research/03 §c).

target_slides.description: Explicit slide count, or 0 to derive it from length_minutes.

density.description: 0 means auto (take the delivery_mode default); otherwise 1-5.
density.$comment: Levels 1-5 map in order onto spec/vocab/density.json (cinematic, talk, briefing, consulting, slidedoc).

polish.description: Effort dial capping layout polish_cost: quick <= 2, standard <= 3, premium any.
polish.$comment: No separate vocab file: the three dial values are defined by the caps recorded in the examples of spec/vocab/polish.json.

verbosity.$comment: Presenton outline API (research/06 §b). No vocab file yet; enum is inline pending one.

content_generation.description: How far the fill step may depart from the source wording.
content_generation.$comment: Presenton outline API (research/06 §b). No vocab file yet; enum is inline pending one.

style_hint.description: Free-text steer for tone and look. Never parsed by the planner.

brand.$comment: Closed enum. Source of truth: spec/vocab/brand.json. JSON Schema cannot load the vocab at runtime, so validate.mjs injects the enum from that file; keep this array in sync with it.
brand.description: Brand the deck is built in.

brand_kit_id.description: Canva Brand Kit id; kAHHTmdCWzo is the alderman.ai kit. Quoted string so PowerShell never coerces it to Int64 (research/06 §e). "-" when not uploaded.

fonts_native_required.description: When true the planner rejects any layout with fonts_native false.

content_public.description: Decision 4: export-bundle refuses to publish unless this is explicitly true.

flow_template.$comment: Closed enum. Source of truth: spec/vocab/flow_template.json. JSON Schema cannot load the vocab at runtime, so validate.mjs injects the enum from that file; keep this array in sync with it.
flow_template.description: The flow the planner actually used.

target_slides.description: Slide budget the planner worked to.

density.$comment: Levels 1-5 map in order onto spec/vocab/density.json (cinematic, talk, briefing, consulting, slidedoc).

layout_sequence.description: Ordered layout ids, one per planned slide. Length must equal the row count of the plan table.

route.$comment: Closed enum. Source of truth: spec/vocab/route.json. JSON Schema cannot load the vocab at runtime, so validate.mjs injects the enum from that file; keep this array in sync with it.
route.description: Upload route chosen for this deck (Decision 3).

unplaced_units.description: Unit ids the budget could not fit. Any unit with must_include true appearing here fails acceptance.

overflow_count.description: Rows in the fit report with unresolved overflow. Must be 0 before fill.
